description: This file contains the implementation of a plot area renderer for clustered bar charts within the PDFsharp charting library. It defines the class 'BarClusteredPlotAreaRenderer' which handles calculating bar positions and determining data inclusion within range for rendering purposes.

classes.name: BarClusteredPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing clustered bar charts, positioning bars side by side within a plot area.

methods.name: CalcBars
methods.description: Calculates the positions, widths, and heights of all bars in the clustered bar chart based on renderer parameters and data points.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Checks whether a given y-value falls within the specified y-range, returning true or false.
